basic_details.job_title: IISER Pune ANRF Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Pune has advertised one ANRF Project Associate-I post (Advt. No. 88/2026) on a project funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), "Phase Separation and Defect Ordering in Active Media". The post is on a temporary and contractual basis, initially for one year, with consolidated emoluments of Rs. 30,000/- per month plus 30% House Rent Allowance. how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application format, given as Apply Now below the advertisement on the institute website.
Convert the application into PDF format.
Email it to [email protected] on or before 27.11.2026.
Write "ANRF Project Associate-I and Advt. No. 88/2026" in the subject line of the email.
Mention all educational qualifications and experience in the relevant field in the application, because the notice says this is in the applicant's interest.
Photocopies of relevant certificates and other testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experience etc.
The notice says these will be collected and verified at an appropriate stage.
important_instructions: The appointed person has no claim of appointment or absorption in the Funding Agency or in IISER Pune. The notice asks candidates to see the institute website regularly for updates.

content_sections.heading: About IISER Pune
content_sections.text: IISER Pune is described in the notice as a premier institute dedicated to research and teaching in the basic sciences. It was established in 2006 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development, renamed Ministry of Education in August 2020. In 2012 it was declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice says the number of posts may vary depending on requirements during the selection process.

rows.pay: Rs. 30,000/- + 30% House Rent Allowance per month

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals fulfilling the advertised criteria may attend the interview for this post. Master's degree in Physics with minimum 70% marks or equivalent CGPA / grade points from a recognized university or equivalent. The qualification must have been obtained from recognized Universities / Institutions. Candidates having experience in particle based simulation techniques relevant to soft matter may be preferred. Not more than 35 years, as on the last date of application. Age relaxation commensurate with educational qualification/s and/or experience/s may be considered for candidates having qualification and experience higher than the advertised, with the prior approval of the competent authority. The notice states that the experience requirement may be relaxed based on the cohort of applications received, with the prior approval of the competent authority. For discipline-specific eligibility, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated emoluments are Rs. 30,000/- per month plus 30% House Rent Allowance. The appointment is initially for one year and may be extended further, subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of the project. It is purely temporary and ends automatically, without notice or compensation, when the project ends. The appointment is governed by the terms and conditions of the funding agency applicable to the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Pune ANRF Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Photocopies of relevant certificates and other testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experience etc. Recent passport size color photograph. The notice says these will be collected and verified at an appropriate stage.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Having the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. If many applications are received, the Project Investigator may restrict the number called to a reasonable limit, on the recommendation of the Screening Committee, considering qualifications and experience over and above the minimum advertised. The interview date has not been announced in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointed person has no claim of appointment or absorption in the Funding Agency or in IISER Pune. If a selected candidate does not join or resigns after joining, waitlisted candidate/s may be offered the position. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing for the interview. No interim enquiries, correspondence or communication of any sort will be entertained. Bringing any influence, political or otherwise, is treated as a disqualification for the post applied for. The notice asks candidates to see the institute website regularly for updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IISER Pune ANRF Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy, 01 (One), for ANRF Project Associate-I under Advt. No. 88/2026. The notice says the number of posts may vary during the selection process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed to [email protected] on or before 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ANRF Project Associate-I at IISER Pune?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Physics with minimum 70% marks or equivalent CGPA / grade points from a recognized university or equivalent. Experience in particle based simulation techniques relevant to soft matter may be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 35 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation may be considered for candidates with higher qualification and experience, with prior approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ANRF Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Consolidated emoluments are Rs. 30,000/- per month plus 30% House Rent Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 30,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice lists the pay as Rs. 30,000/- plus 30% House Rent Allowance per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the application in the prescribed format, converted into PDF, to [email protected] with the subject "ANRF Project Associate-I and Advt. No. 88/2026".

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are interviewed online through Zoom. They are informed by e-mail only, and the list is put up on the institute website.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is temporary and contractual, for one year initially and extendable subject to performance and continuation of the project. It ends automatically when the project ends.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be admissible for appearing for the interview.
